severity_report_onsets_footprint.definition: minor 0 games missed; short 1-2; multi_week 3-8; long_term 9+ (incl. not seen again with 9+ club games left)

recommended.label_key: Confirmed = computed directly from D1-D3 by the builder; Pattern = derived from data plus a stated assumption or literature cross-check; Unverified = assumption without a direct 2012 source
recommended.structure: Two onset streams. (1) Game onsets drawn on the possession stream per player-snap of actual participation (scrimmage, special teams and penalty-nullified snaps). (2) Optional between-game (practice/non-game) onsets drawn once per club-week, never removing anyone from a game, with the between-game class mix. Each game onset draws class (game mix), then severity conditional on class, then an in-game removal decision.

game_onsets_per_team_game.label: Pattern
game_onsets_per_team_game.basis: 4.075 report onsets per team-game (Confirmed, D1) times an estimated game-attributable share of 0.60-0.80 (L1 game vs practice AE rates with ~3 in-season practices per game; L5 hamstring regular-season practice vs game rates). Floor: in-game stoppages alone 1.098 per team-game (Confirmed, D2).

player_snaps_per_team_game_2012.label: Confirmed
player_snaps_per_team_game_2012.basis: 11 x exposure plays per game: 41,758 exposure plays / 256 games (run, pass, kickoff, punt, extra point, field goal, kneel, spike and 1,478 snapped no_play rows; 2,716 timeout and pre-snap-foul no_play rows excluded). Verification pass corrected the research-pass 1,891, which counted every no_play row as a snap.

mean_game_onset_hazard_per_player_snap.label: Pattern
mean_game_onset_hazard_per_player_snap.basis: 2.8 / 1,794; the kernel must normalize on its own participation ledger so expected onsets per team-game equal game_onsets_per_team_game

position_relative_risk_per_snap.label: Pattern
position_relative_risk_per_snap.basis: Group share of onsets (report D1 and in-game stoppages D2, both Confirmed) divided by an assumed 2012 on-field slot share (QB 1, OL 5, RB 1.25, WR 2.45, TE 1.3; DL 3.7, LB 2.5, DB 4.8 of 22). Slot shares are Unverified (2012 has no public participation data, D4). Report-based RR: QB .59 RB 1.70 WR 1.32 TE 1.06 OL .64 DL .84 LB 1.30 DB .99; in-game RR (corrected note attribution): QB .74 RB 1.41 WR 1.07 TE .60 OL .63 DL .80 LB 1.24 DB 1.41. Values are the rounded mean of the two. Specialists: in-game RR about 0.2 per kick snap; report-based about 1.0 includes practice kicking strains; 0.30 chosen.
position_relative_risk_per_snap.caveat: RB/WR/LB/DB shares include special-teams injuries while slots count scrimmage only; per-snap RR for those groups is slightly overstated. Recalibrate once the kernel records actual snaps.

head_neck_share.label: Pattern
head_neck_share.note: Replaces the uniform 25% draw. In-game stoppages that reached the next report were 22.9% head/neck (Confirmed D1+D2, n=284).

severity_bands.definition: games missed with weekly games: minor 0 (return within 6 days), short 1-2 (7-20 days), multi_week 3-8 (21-62 days), long_term 9+ or season-ending (63-180 days)
severity_bands.label: Pattern (day ranges follow from the weekly game cadence; within-band distribution uniform is Unverified)

severity_mix_all_onsets.label: Pattern
severity_mix_all_onsets.basis: footprint report onsets .775/.151/.064/.010 (Confirmed D1+D2, n=918, 63 censored) and footprint in-game stoppages .752/.141/.065/.042 (n=262, 61 censored), plus unreported severe vanishes (20 cases, 0.039 per team-game, upper bound) and a censoring correction toward longer bands

rest_of_game_removals_per_team_game.label: Pattern
rest_of_game_removals_per_team_game.basis: No 2012 source measures removals directly. 1.098 official injury stoppages per team-game (Confirmed); at least 45.4% of footprint players recorded a later play in the same game, so stoppage-linked removals are at most about 0.60. Removals without an injury timeout are unobserved. Time-loss game onsets (2.8 x 0.24 = 0.67) plus head/neck medical holds on minor injuries give about 0.9-1.0. 0.95 is the value implied by the recommended mix and removal probabilities, not a measured rate.

removal_probability_by_severity.label: Pattern. Implied removals = 2.8 x [0.18 x 1.0 + 0.82 x (0.76 x 0.05 + 0.15 x 0.45 + 0.09 x 1.0)] = 0.95 per team-game, inside the 0.6-1.1 band. head_neck removal follows the independent medical hold already in canon, not a rate estimate.

position_order_checks: RB, LB, DB, WR per-snap risk above OL, QB, DL

class_mix_game_onsets.label: Pattern
class_mix_game_onsets.basis: Report head/neck onsets are 0.452 per team-game (Confirmed D1); adding under-listed concussions to the literature midpoint (0.19-0.34, i.e. +0.05) gives about 0.50. Assuming head/neck onsets are game injuries (Unverified), 0.50 / 2.8 game onsets = 0.18 (range 0.14-0.21: 80% game origin with no adjustment to 100% game origin at the 0.34 concussion figure). The other 0.82 is split in the report ratio lower .694 / upper .190 / trunk .116. Stoppages that reached the next report were 22.9% head/neck (Confirmed D1+D2, n=284). The research pass applied the all-report mix (head/neck 0.135) to game onsets, which gave 0.378 head/neck per team-game, fewer than the reports themselves listed.

class_mix_between_game_onsets.label: Pattern
class_mix_between_game_onsets.basis: Report class totals minus game onsets at the game mix; head/neck near zero follows from the Unverified game-origin assumption above.

limitations: Injury reports under-record minor injuries not affecting practice and over-record Probable carryovers; a new body part on a report is not a diagnosis.
Report onsets mix game and practice injuries; the game share is estimated, not observed.
Players placed on reserve before the Wednesday report never appear; the footprint check bounds this at about 0.04 per team-game among regular contributors.
Games missed is inferred from play-by-play footprints; offensive linemen are excluded and a player who plays without recording a stat looks absent (bias toward longer).
Week 1 listings (camp carryovers) and the Week 17 game (no following regular-season report) are outside the onset window.
In-game stoppage notes require an official injury timeout; injuries without a stoppage are missed.
Weekly-roster ACT/RES status for 2012 is back-filled and unusable for reserve timing.
Literature full texts were proxy-blocked; literature values come from abstracts/search summaries and are labelled accordingly.
